Subsequent source refactors carried that wording into source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml.

The later FHIR-16861 reconciliation already on the combined branch fixed adjacent CodeSystem content-mode wording while preserving the FHIR-16738 resource-instance clarification. reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative XML definition is correct, and the remaining SVG-only mismatch should be handled by diagram regeneration rather than a manual source-changing commit whose only edit is to a generated artifact.
